Exploring Vice City like it’s real life. 🌴🚗

Just another peaceful day in the streets of Leonida. 🎮

Created with @CuddlerAI 

Prompt:

Create a breathtaking 60-second photorealistic open-world gameplay experience that looks like somebody is actually playing the next-generation Grand Theft Auto VI, except the entire game world looks indistinguishable from real-life camera footage.

The video must feel like authentic uninterrupted gameplay, not a cinematic movie trailer, not an AI-generated montage and not a collection of unrelated scenes.

CORE CONCEPT:
A young man spends an ordinary afternoon in Vice City, Leonida. He leaves his luxury apartment, gets into his car, drives through the beautiful coastal city, visits a convenience store, purchases snacks and drinks, and continues driving through the city at sunset.
This is a peaceful, immersive everyday-life simulation.

ABSOLUTE CHARACTER LOCK — MOST IMPORTANT:

There is ONLY ONE MAIN HUMAN CHARACTER in this entire video.

Create one original fictional 28-year-old male protagonist with:

Short dark brown hair.
Natural attractive facial features.
Light stubble.
Realistic skin texture and natural facial proportions.
White premium fitted T-shirt.
Black relaxed-fit trousers.
White sneakers.
A silver wristwatch.
His face, hairstyle, body shape, clothing and identity MUST remain EXACTLY IDENTICAL in every scene.

Never generate a replacement protagonist.
Never introduce another main character.
Never change his face between camera angles.
Never change his clothing.
Never create duplicate versions of him.

The same protagonist must physically move from one activity to the next.
VEHICLE LOCK:
One specific black luxury four-door sports sedan with realistic paint, detailed headlights, black alloy wheels and premium interior.
The exact same vehicle must appear throughout the entire video.
Do not change the vehicle model, color, wheels, interior or proportions.

LOCATION — AUTHENTIC VICE CITY:

Recreate the atmosphere of GTA VI's fictional Vice City in the state of Leonida.

Use visual inspiration from:

Ocean Beach: pastel Art Deco architecture, beachside hotels, palm trees and beautiful coastal streets.

Washington Beach: modern beachfront roads and residential areas.

Downtown Vice City: glass skyscrapers, elevated roads and busy urban traffic.

South Florida-inspired convenience stores and shopping streets.

Beautiful Florida sunshine, turquoise coastal atmosphere, realistic American road markings, authentic traffic signals, tropical vegetation and detailed city architecture.
GAMEPLAY CAMERA:
The entire video must use a genuine third-person open-world gameplay camera.
Camera position: approximately 3–4 meters behind the protagonist when walking and slightly elevated behind the car when driving.
Camera should follow the protagonist naturally, just like a real player controlling a character with a gaming controller.

Use smooth player-controlled camera movement, natural tracking, realistic walking animations, believable car physics and continuous environmental movement.

Show a subtle, professionally designed original open-world game HUD at the bottom of the screen. Keep it minimal and stable. No incorrect or unreadable text.

60-SECOND GAMEPLAY SEQUENCE:

SCENE 1 — 00:00–00:10
LEAVING THE APARTMENT

Start directly in third-person gameplay.

The protagonist exits a beautiful modern luxury apartment building in Vice City during a sunny afternoon.

The camera follows him from behind as he walks naturally across the entrance driveway toward his parked black sports sedan.

He presses his car key. The headlights flash briefly.

He opens the driver's door and sits inside.
SCENE 2 — 00:10–00:20
GETTING READY TO DRIVE

Show a brief realistic third-person view of the same character sitting inside the exact same car.

He places his hands on the steering wheel, starts the engine, adjusts his position and looks through the windshield.

Show a realistic dashboard, detailed leather seats and natural reflections on the windshield.

The camera smoothly transitions to a third-person vehicle-following gameplay view.

SCENE 3 — 00:20–00:35
EXPLORING VICE CITY

The protagonist drives peacefully through the streets of Ocean Beach and Washington Beach.
Show stunning pastel-colored Art Deco buildings, palm-lined roads, beachfront hotels, pedestrians walking, realistic traffic, cyclists, road intersections and beautiful coastal scenery.

The car drives at a normal speed.

He stops at a red traffic signal, waits for the green light and continues driving.

Include realistic vehicle suspension, wheel movement, reflections, shadows and road interactions.

The environment must feel alive and naturally populated.

SCENE 4 — 00:35–00:43
ARRIVING AT THE STORE
The protagonist turns into a small modern convenience store parking area.

He parks his exact black sedan in a parking space.

He switches off the engine, opens the driver's door, steps out and walks toward the automatic entrance.

The third-person camera follows him smoothly.

SCENE 5 — 00:43–00:53
REALISTIC SHOPPING EXPERIENCE

Show the SAME protagonist inside a beautifully detailed American convenience store.

He walks naturally between shelves containing chips, chocolate, bottled water, cold drinks and snacks.

He picks up one packet of chips, one chocolate bar and a cold drink.
He walks to the checkout counter and places the items down.

A cashier scans the products and he pays normally.

He picks up his shopping bag.

Keep the protagonist's exact same face, hairstyle, outfit and physical appearance.

SCENE 6 — 00:53–01:00
BACK INTO THE OPEN WORLD

The protagonist exits the store carrying the shopping bag.
He walks toward the exact same black sports sedan.

He opens the driver's door, places the shopping bag on the passenger seat and gets inside.

The camera moves back to the familiar third-person gameplay position.

The car smoothly drives away along a beautiful Vice City coastal boulevard.

End with a gorgeous view of the palm-lined road, ocean reflections and warm golden-hour sunlight.

VISUAL QUALITY — EXTREMELY IMPORTANT:

Aim for the highest possible photorealism.

The video must look like actual real-world footage rendered inside an advanced next-generation open-world game.

Realistic human anatomy and facial expressions.
Natural human walking and hand movements.

Physically accurate vehicle movement.

Detailed vehicle interiors and exterior reflections.

Realistic glass, pavement, concrete and vegetation textures.

Natural sunlight and global illumination.

Accurate environmental shadows.

Realistic pedestrians and traffic behavior.

Detailed convenience store interiors and products.

Professional cinematic color science.

Natural motion blur.

Highly detailed environmental geometry.
Realistic depth of field without excessive blur.
CONTINUITY RULES:
This is one continuous ordinary day experienced by ONE character.
The same man must remain visually identical from the first frame to the final frame.
The same black car must remain identical.
Every action must logically connect to the next action.
No teleportation, no sudden location changes, no random character replacements, no duplicate people resembling the protagonist, no clothing changes and no vehicle changes.
NEGATIVE INSTRUCTIONS:
Absolutely NO police chases.
NO weapons.
NO fighting.
NO robberies.
NO explosions.
NO action-movie sequences.
NO running.
NO dramatic stunts.
NO random cinematic montage.
NO cartoon graphics.
NO plastic-looking skin.
NO distorted faces.
NO extra fingers.
NO floating objects.
NO artificial character movements.
NO random scene changes.
NO AI-looking visual glitches.
FINAL CREATIVE DIRECTION:
The audience should feel that they are watching an actual next-generation GTA VI open-world gameplay session, except the graphics are so realistic that the city, character, car, shopping experience and everyday activities look like genuine real-life footage.
The experience must be peaceful, immersive, beautiful, incredibly detailed and visually believable.

The most important priority is CHARACTER CONSISTENCY, followed by REALISM, GAMEPLAY CAMERA AUTHENTICITY and ENVIRONMENTAL DETAIL.

Duration: 60 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape.
Visual style: Ultra-photorealistic next-generation open-world gameplay.
